title: Item:Airship Sail Cloth
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{Top}} {| | rowspan="2" | [[File:Airship Color Change Red icon.png|100px|left]] | '''Standard''' ''for'' {{Cost|295|inline=TRUE}} |- | '''Blue, Green, Orange, Purple, Red, White''' ''for'' {{Cost|495|inline=TRUE}} |} Airship Sail Cloth is a consumable only available from the [[DDO Store#Airship Color Changes|DDO Store]]. * Can not be purchase unless the purchasing character is in a guild. This item lets you change the color of awnings above the captain’s area (on certain airships) and above doorways. {{Unverified|Note: Airship Sail Cloth may also change the cloth like fins on certain airships.}} * Can only be used when on the guild airship. * This color will be permanent until changed to a new color. == Blue Airship Sail Cloth ==
